title: Ukrainian Quenched Cheese Gratin
description: A rich and creamy gratin made with Ukrainian-style quenched cheese, perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: In a large saucepan, sauté the chopped onion over medium heat until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the quenched cheese until melted.
Add the flour to thicken the sauce, cooking for 1 minute.
Remove from heat and stir in the softened butter until melted.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the cheese mixture to the prepared baking dish.
Top with chopped parsley and a sprinkle of salt.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5-10 minutes before serving.
